💡 Unsupervised Topic Modeling: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA)
  • What is LDA? An unsupervised machine learning algorithm that discovers hidden thematic clusters from patient review vocabulary without manual tagging.
  • Term Probability (β): Quantifies the probability of a word occurring within a specific clinical topic. Higher values signify signature thematic keywords.
  • Topic Prevalence (γ): The estimated proportion of patient reviews addressing that theme over monthly cohorts.

Topic 1 & 2: Clinical Execution

Dominated by wait, triage, delay, billing, insurance, surprise. The primary causes of legal escalations and negative public reviews.

Healytics Executive Guide & Methodology

1. What is Healytics?

Healytics is an end-to-end Healthcare Natural Language Processing (NLP) intelligence platform. While traditional star ratings only reflect whether a patient was satisfied, Healytics analyzes unstructured clinical reviews to explain why patients praise or complain, isolating performance across 5 specific clinical and administrative dimensions.

2. The 5 Core Aspect Dimensions Explained
  • Doctor Care: Evaluates physician communication, bedside empathy, diagnostic clarity, and treatment thoroughness.
  • Nursing Staff: Evaluates call button response time, vitals monitoring, pain management, and bedside compassion.
  • Cleanliness: Evaluates room hygiene, sanitized bathrooms, linen freshness, and hospital environmental safety.
  • Waiting Time: Measures patient frustration with emergency triage delays, intake queues, and appointment lag.
  • Billing Transparency: Analyzes billing clarity, unexpected surprise fees, insurance dispute resolution, and administrative desk support.
3. Metric Reference & Interpretations
  • Patient Experience Index (PEI, 0–100): A composite quality metric calculated from normalized star rating, sentence polarity balance, and aspect sentiment. 80+ is World-Class; 60–79 is Stable; below 60 requires operational intervention.
  • Net Sentiment Balance (% Points): Calculated as % Positive Sentences - % Negative Sentences. It is the NLP equivalent of Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Priority Quadrant Matrix: Combines Driver Importance Weight (how much an aspect impacts overall ratings) with current patient satisfaction. Top-Left is designated "Fix First" (Velvet Burgundy) — issues here represent the fastest path to improving institutional reputation.
